notes_for_editor: Thin record: four sources, none describing this tower's build, staffing or fate. Identity of Loc 2 rests on the 2011 Texas tower list, whose livingston coordinates match the FFLA Loc 2 entry exactly (30.73547, -94.90426). The Forest Lookouts Livingston page is a title block (county, agency) and does not say whether it covers Loc 1 or Loc 2, the same limit as the existing Loc 1 record. The 1930 agreement is county context only; no source ties it to this tower. Brief access 'unknown' is not an allowed level, so no access key is written. Two WebSearch calls, an empty Portal to Texas History exact-phrase search and about six page reads found no Livingston-specific history. Untried leads: Polk County newspaper archive on the Portal to Texas History and the book Fire in the Piney Woods. Story is about 130 words.
